english:
A slab of rotting flesh wired to a cracked femur, thrown to buy you a way out.

The nearest zombie breaks off whatever it is doing - including chasing you - and stops to eat. ONE zombie per pile: a horde will not all stop for the same meal, so bring enough.

Feed the SAME zombie four times and it stops looking at you like food. It follows you, it fights everything else that moves, it never touches a player, and it leaves your walls alone.

Ferals, radiated and charged can all be turned - they just want more.

Hold to aim, release to throw. It only works once it hits the ground.

Gore rendered down in a pot and cut with acid until the smell carries half again as far.

Pulls from further out, is eaten faster, and counts as two feeds - which is the sane way to turn a radiated zombie, because standing next to one through eight separate meals rarely ends well.

Fed to a zombie that is already yours, it patches it back up instead.
